_comment: Declarative config applied by register.sh. Layout matches the stable Zitadel v2 Target proto (proto/zitadel/action/v2/target.proto): name/endpoint/timeout/payloadType live at the top level of the target; interruptOnError is inside the target-type submessage. restCall (NOT restWebhook) is required for claim injection — webhook targets only consume the status code and would make this a no-op, since MkAuth returns the claim envelope in the response body.

restCall._note: interruptOnError:false keeps token issuance unblocked if MkAuth is unreachable. MkAuth handles per-project fail_closed / minimal_safe inside the response (the handler always returns 200 with the correct envelope), so this target-level setting is purely a transport-layer safety net for MkAuth outages.

executions._note: Inject custom claims into access tokens (JWT).
Inject the same custom claims into ID tokens / userinfo responses so OIDC clients see them consistently.
